Remark
Please let us know if you need to check actual photos(not PS-modified)
Introduction
STC-110GE provides media conversion between 10/100/1000Base-T and 1000Base-SX/LX interfaces for various distances(0.5/2/20/40/60/80/100km)and can be widely used in FTTX projects
It supports SC/ST/FC/SFP fiber optic ports.
(Optional)Enhanced DIP functions as below make available flexible usage
LFP
Network storm suppression
Forced 100M fiber speed
Forced 100M network speed
Key Features
1*10/100/1000MBASE-T RJ45 port, 1*1000MBASE-X SC/ST/FC/SFP optical port
IEEE802.3,  IEEE802.3u, IEEE802.3z and IEEE802.3ab standard compliant
Support auto MDI/MDI-X function and half/full-duplex of FX
Support 1M Large buffer and 10Kbytes Jumbo frame
Fan-less design, support plug and play installation
Support watchdog function, which can restart the equipment automatically when it is frozen
Full- positioned LEDs to indicate power and network status
Transmission distance 2KM～100KM optional
4KV surge protection; ESD: 8KV/contact, 15KV/air protection
Specification
Product Name	2 port 1000M Ethernet Media Converter
Port	1*10/100/1000M Base-T RJ45 port / 1*1000M Base-X SC/ST/FC/SFP optical port
Network Protocol	IEEE802.3 10Base-T Ethernet / IEEE802.3u 100Base-TX Fast Ethernet / IEEE802.3ab 1000Base-T / IEEE802.3z 1000Base-SX Gigabit Ethernet
IEEE 802.3x full-duplex flow control
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m)
Fiber Option	50/125μm or 62.5/125μm multi-mode fiber optic cable, up to 2km / 9/125μm single-mode fiber optic cable, up to 100km
Switching Capacity	14G
Throughput	10.416M
Packet Buffer	1M
MAC Address	8K
Jumbo Frame	10Kbytes
Transfer Mode	Store and forward, forwarding delay<5us
MDX/MIDX	Support
Watchdog	Support
MTBF	100,000 hours
Thermal Method	Fan-less, natural heat dissipation
Installation Method	Desktop, wall mount, 14-slot chassis mount
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -20℃~70℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~85℃ / Relative Humidity: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Input Voltage	DC5-12V
DC Jack
Total Power Consumption	Full loading ≤1.6W
Industry Standard	Surge protection of power: IEC 61000-4-5  Level 4(4KV)(8/20us)
Surge protection of Ethernet ports: IEC 61000-4-5  Level 3(2KV)(10/700us) / ESD: IEC 61000-4-2  Level 4(8K/15K) / Free fall: 0.5-meter
LED Indicators	PWR: Power indicator / FDX: Electrical port operation mode indicator / Link/Act: Link state indicator / Copper 100M Link: Electrical port speed rate indicator / Copper 1000M Link: Electrical port speed rate indicator / Fiber Link/Act: Fiber port link state indicator

FAQ
Leadtime
Production starts AFTER payment is received
Please know that it usually takes 1~2 working days for our bank to receive the payment
Production time is usually 4~7 working days for standard(non-customized)models(no more than 50Pcs)
Shipping time is usually 4~7 days by express
In total, it takes 10~15 calendar days to arrive at local customs for clearance
This is an estimated period, it usually does not take this long to receive the order
Shipment
We will send the goods by express(DHL, UPS or FEDEX)or by sea(for bulk orders)
It is fine to ship purchased items via client’s shipping account(DHL, UPS or FEDEX)or forwarders in China
MoQ
1 Pc/Pair(It is NOT free, Saga Telecom do NOT do FREE SAMPLES)
It is fine to have sample testing before bulk orders
Please know that we do NOT suggest 1pc/pair in sample testing, better make it at least 2 pieces/pairs in case of any possible dysfunction in production/transportation(then all efforts are gone, a big waste of time)

1 year for commercial models(STC series)and 3 years for industrial models(STI series)
Please kindly refer to the “Warranty Policy” for more information

The price negotiation makes sense ONLY IF a client is satisfied with the quality
For distributorship, that we are now seeking, best prices will be provided

FULL PAYMENT for a customization order BEFORE PRODUCTION(non-negotiated)

It is standard charge 25usd for EACH T/T transfer whatever the invoice value is
It is 5usd for every 100usd to PayPal a/c, this ratio is standard charge by PayPal

ent and let us know this problem(we will improve)

Available

CKD usually involves confidential information such as BOM list, schematic design, PCB layout etc.

OEM
Available

Relevant cooperation information will not be leaked to a third party without client’s permission

Industrial manufacturing

Use client’s packing box
Design client’s product PVC sticker
Customize some parts of a model like rear panel/power input terminal block/panels...

Change IP address
MAC address
SNMP, OID

Commercial Contract
A framework will be built and agreed upon to boost efficiency and transparency in daily business negotiations and transactions.
It covers, NOT LIMITED TO
Terms of Payment
Delivery
Quality
Warranty
Return Merchandise Authorization(RMA)
Export Clauses
Other General Obligations
...
Inside Saga Telecom, there are standards about above-listed points
We are open to discussion based on orders and cases
When this framework between buyers and sellers is established, it will be strictly exercised if without significant changes in the cooperation
This framework will be renewed ON QUARTARLY BASIS

Ordering

Move on to “Ordering” stage if every detail is finalized

Wait for next business opportunity

Via Saga Telecom’s shipping agent, we will quote based on total weight to buyer. It is usually air service by DHL/FedEx/UPS, cost will be included in PI after buyer approves

Shipping number

After-sales Support
Warranty comes in effect from the date of delivery(trackable by the AWB number)
A “certificate of warranty” will be issued to indicate the coverage and relevant information
If you have no idea how to install/configure/use the purchased devices, please contact us
A detailed introduction will be shared
If something is faulty in usage(especially managed models)
1, please describe what happened, examples as below
When this problem occurred
What you did to adjust it like restart the device or change new accessories
How you use this device like outdoor use for connecting some IP cameras
With this information, Saga Telecom could quickly know what is going on and do trouble-shooting
2, please do your best to provide as many actual photos/videos as possible
Wrong connection or improper use may occur, photos and videos are helpful and efficient
It is NOT suggested to discuss after-sales issues ONLY by text, we find it difficult to understand the situation and find out the root reasons
At the same time, we know that it might not be easy to get some photos/videos due to different reasons
Please try your best(at least draw a sketch or something), this is the most efficient method based on many after-sales cases
3, please prepare necessary accessories such as new SFP modules/other brand switches...
An example is, in a linear network connection, if one SFP module fails, the whole system might have a transmission problem
The solution would be as simple as replacing a new workable SFP module
With in-hand accessories, sometimes it is easy to fix the problem
4, please get ready for online meeting
If early tests and communication failed to identify the problem, an online meeting will be held to better discuss the after-sales issues(usually on Zoom or Microsoft Teams)
Saga Telecom might remotely control your PC to do trouble-shooting with the help of Teamviewer/Anydesk
Please do NOT wire or test the devices casually without our knowing, just follow our instructions and our engineers will do next moves based on the feedback

Saga Telecom warrants that the supplied models will be free of defects in materials, workmanship, and comply with standard functions indicated in the product datasheet
Warranty period is 1 year for commercial models(STC series)and 3 years for industrial models(STI series), for the product category that is not listed in below still follows the rule

Warranty comes in effect from the date of delivery(trackable by the AWB number)
Purchased items are seen as standard or non-defective without negative feedback within 2 months from the date of delivery
Warranty is non-transferable and will be solely provided to the original buyer as per the invoice information
Immediate contact is strongly advised once any problem occurs, Saga Telecom should be well informed all along before standard solution is provided
Please properly keep purchase-related information(purchase order, proforma invoice, packing list etc.)for any possible repair, replacement or after-sales issues
Please do not remove or ruin the product label(there is serial number)on the device
Please do not repair or replace components of purchased items without our knowing or authorization
Unauthorized returns are not accepted without a valid confirmation from Saga Telecom, any risk or expenses involved are not covered in such cases
At Saga Telecom’s option, the disputed device will be preferably repaired or replaced
Defective products within warranty but unable to be repaired or discontinued, 10%~20% discount will be offered when the customer purchases the alternative models with identical service features
If there are expenses during the repair, Saga Telecom will negotiate with the customer on how to split the cost, and generally give discounts in new orders to cover this cost
Saga Telecom reserves final adjudication rights and sole discretion during the warranty period
Exclusive Liability
Out of warranty period
Order of wrong models
Huge defects due to improper use including but not limited to circuit burnout, PCB board deformation, water-soaked chip
Hardware and software compatibility failure
Consumable materials and routine maintenance such as a fuse or bracket
Unauthorized modification to important components

Saga Telecom is a reliable manufacturer and trader of good-quality fiber optic devices and transmission solutions, and focuses on industrial networking, CCTV surveillance, fiber optic transmission and featured optical fiber devices for industrial automation, vehicle network, security monitoring etc.
Backed by diversified product portfolio and mature business system, Saga Telecom gains good feedback overseas especially in USA and EU market
In the meantime, Saga Telecom is actively seeking trustworthy partners and enhancing its presence in the network telecommunications field

After-sales Support
Warranty comes in effect from the date of delivery(trackable by the AWB number)
A “certificate of warranty” will be issued to indicate the coverage and relevant information
If you have no idea how to install/configure/use the purchased devices, please contact us
A detailed introduction will be shared
If something is faulty in usage(especially managed models)
1, please describe what happened, examples as below
When this problem occurred
What you did to adjust it like restart the device or change new accessories
How you use this device like outdoor use for connecting some IP cameras
With this information, Saga Telecom could quickly know what is going on and do trouble-shooting
2, please do your best to provide as many actual photos/videos as possible
Wrong connection or improper use may occur, photos and videos are helpful and efficient
It is NOT suggested to discuss after-sales issues ONLY by text, we find it difficult to understand the situation and find out the root reasons
At the same time, we know that it might not be easy to get some photos/videos due to different reasons
Please try your best(at least draw a sketch or something), this is the most efficient method based on many after-sales cases
3, please prepare necessary accessories such as new SFP modules/other brand switches...
An example is, in a linear network connection, if one SFP module fails, the whole system might have a transmission problem
The solution would be as simple as replacing a new workable SFP module
With in-hand accessories, sometimes it is easy to fix the problem
4, please get ready for online meeting
If early tests and communication failed to identify the problem, an online meeting will be held to better discuss the after-sales issues(usually on Zoom or Microsoft Teams)
Saga Telecom might remotely control your PC to do trouble-shooting with the help of Teamviewer/Anydesk
Please do NOT wire or test the devices casually without our knowing, just follow our instructions and our engineers will do next moves based on the feedback
